sandevistan.tooltip.immuno.2: Removes up to %s cyberpsychosis; when each dose ends, %s%% of it comes back (it never lowers max Mind). Sneak and hit another player to inject them. Using several in a row (within 3 minutes) weakens it.
sandevistan.mindzero: Your Mind hit 0%! It hurts (3 hearts), and using it now costs 2 hearts every 8 s of use while cyberpsychosis keeps building.
sandevistan.psy.on: The cyberpsychosis symptoms are setting in...
sandevistan.psy.limit: CYBERPSYCHOSIS AT 100%! It can still go higher.

sandevistan.tooltip.stabilizer.2: With Good Mind, each second has a 5% chance to recover 1 max Mind, and it lowers cyberpsychosis
sandevistan.immuno.used: Immunosuppressant: +%s current Mind and -%s cyberpsychosis for now.
sandevistan.immuno.end: A dose wore off: %s cyberpsychosis came back.

sandevistan.implant.tip.2: Absurd speed, jump and mining; Strength, Haste, Resistance and Night Vision.
sandevistan.implant.tip.3: Dodges 50% of attacks and projectiles, hits harder knockback, and eating, drinking and bows are faster.
sandevistan.implant.tip.4: Costs Mind (5 to turn on). Overuse causes cyberpsychosis.

sandevistan.tooltip.neural.2: Right-click a chip to insert it; remove it in the implants tab. No doctor needed.
sandevistan.tooltip.chip.1: Right-click to insert it into the Neural Link.
sandevistan.tooltip.chip.2: Takes 10 s to download. Costs %s permanent Mind while inserted.
sandevistan.tooltip.chip.3: Cyberware Load: +%s%%. Repair on an anvil with redstone or iron.
sandevistan.tooltip.chip.walker: Jump Boost I, 20% less fall damage and Dolphin's Grace.
sandevistan.tooltip.bone.1: +%s armor, +%s%% knockback resistance and %s%% less fall damage.
sandevistan.variant.tip.zetatech: Doubles your damage, and gives even more while airborne (jumping or falling).
sandevistan.variant.tip.qiant: Defensive: huge resistance and takes half damage, protected by thermal-energy shields.

sandevistan.tab.effects.title: What each implant is doing to your body
sandevistan.eff.neural: Lets you use up to 2 chips (0% load).
sandevistan.tooltip.heart.2: All healing (food, natural regeneration, etc.) restores %2$s%% more. No potion effects.
sandevistan.tooltip.leg.1: Per leg: +%s%% movement speed, higher jump (+%s) and %s%% less fall damage.
sandevistan.tooltip.leg.3: Choose the right or left leg at the Ripperdoc. You can install two.
sandevistan.eff.leg: %s leg(s): +%s%% speed, higher jump, -%s%% fall damage.
sandevistan.vis.title: Visibility
sandevistan.rip.greet.crit.1: Your head is nearly empty, kid. Stop with the implants. Listen to me, this is no joke.
sandevistan.rip.greet.crit.2: I have seen people in this state. It ends badly. Rest and get treated before anything else.
sandevistan.rip.greet.low.1: Your mind is in tatters. I will not refuse you, but you need treatment.
sandevistan.rip.greet.low.2: Careful. Every point of Mind you lose does not come back easily. Take it easy.
sandevistan.rip.greet.load.1: Your body is at its Cyberware Load limit. A little more and your head cracks.
sandevistan.rip.greet.load.2: All that load will drive you mad. Think twice before putting more metal in you.
sandevistan.rip.greet.many.1: So much metal! You are turning into a machine part. Do not overdo it, kid.
sandevistan.rip.greet.many.2: I charge per implant, but even I think you already have too many.
sandevistan.rip.greet.mind.1: Your head is not as good as it used to be. A Stabilizer helps, you know?
sandevistan.rip.greet.mind.2: I have noticed some glitches in your mind. Do not ignore that.
sandevistan.rip.greet.psy.1: I can see the signs of cyberpsychosis in you. An Immunosuppressant fixes it, for now.
sandevistan.rip.greet.psy.2: Your head is restless. Breathe and watch what you do.
sandevistan.rip.sand.1: That Sandevistan on your back is beautiful, but it burns your head. Do not abuse it.
sandevistan.rip.greet.some.1: A implant or two suits you. How about one more? Fair price, of course.
sandevistan.rip.greet.some.2: You are adapting well. What will it be today?
sandevistan.rip.greet.none.1: Still flesh and bone, huh? I can fix that. What will it be?
sandevistan.rip.greet.none.2: Come in, make yourself at home. Here we improve on what nature made.
sandevistan.rip.after.ok.1: Done, it looks great. Take it easy the first few days.
sandevistan.rip.after.ok.2: Clean surgery. If it hurts, that is normal. Come back if you need anything.
sandevistan.rip.after.many.1: Done. But look, with so many implants you are playing with fire.
sandevistan.rip.after.many.2: One more for the collection. I warned you: the more metal, the less you.
sandevistan.rip.load.after.1: Done... but your Cyberware Load is past the safe limit. Do not blame me later.
sandevistan.rip.remove.1: Implant removed. Your body thanks you, and so does your mind.
sandevistan.rip.remove.2: Removed with no problems. Sometimes less is more.
sandevistan.rip.near.2: Watch your step. This place is for people who know what they want.
sandevistan.rip.near.3: If you want to talk, just come over. I do not bite... much.
sandevistan.tooltip.chip.ram: Raises the Cyberware Load limit by %1$s%%: load-driven Insanity only starts rising at %2$s%%. Adds no Load and only wears down while load is above 70%%.
sandevistan.tooltip.pill.1: Lowers Insanity by %s per second for 30 s (%s total). Only works if you have Insanity.
sandevistan.tooltip.pill.2: Does not affect cyberpsychosis (use the Immunosuppressant for that).
sandevistan.pill.used: Pill taken: Insanity will drop for %s s.

sandevistan.battery.rate: Charge: up to %s FE per tick
sandevistan.battery.use: Right-click to install in your body.
sandevistan.energy.hint: Click the installed battery to take it out, or a battery from your inventory to install it (the current one goes back to your inventory) — swap whenever you like. Energy implants only work with a battery, and each one raises the others' consumption by 10%. Charge it in the Charger, powered by generators next to it or by other mods (FE).
sandevistan.energy.charger: Charger: %s/%s FE | Battery: %s/%s FE (sneak to view, click to take out)
sandevistan.ext.title: Installed extra implants (the Ripperdoc installs and removes)
sandevistan.ext.keys: Hold Alt and scroll to switch ability; R uses it. G: eyes (zoom: hold)  H: Scanner
sandevistan.tooltip.ext.energy: Uses battery energy (each energy implant raises the others' consumption by 10%).
sandevistan.tooltip.ext.use: Take it to the Ripperdoc to install.
sandevistan.tooltip.ext.boot: One foot: softens %s%% of falls and glides. Two feet: %s%% and short flight near the ground. Needs a battery.
sandevistan.tooltip.ext.jet: Free flight (jump twice). With the Sandevistan on you fly faster and use half the energy.
sandevistan.tooltip.ext.xray: Shows ores through walls for 10 s (radius %s blocks). Total cooldown %s s.
sandevistan.tooltip.ext.eye1: Zoom from 2x up to %sx: hold G or pick it on the wheel; scroll to adjust.
sandevistan.tooltip.ext.eye2: Toggles a living-being silhouette through walls (%s blocks range).
sandevistan.tooltip.ext.eye3: Charges for %s s then fires a long-range laser (%s damage and fire). 3 s cooldown.
sandevistan.tooltip.ext.eye4: Toggles night and thermal vision (living beings in orange up to %s blocks).
sandevistan.ext.docTitle: Extra implants (eye pair: one type at a time)
sandevistan.ext.toDoctor: Take it to the Ripperdoc to install.
sandevistan.tooltip.ext.solar: Head panel: recharges %s FE/s into the battery in daylight and open sky (half in rain).
sandevistan.tooltip.ext.reactor: Chest reactor: recharges %s FE/s into the battery all the time, day or night.
sandevistan.tooltip.ext.mantis: Forearm blade: +%s melee damage (like a sword) and your hands stay free. One on each arm adds +1.
sandevistan.tooltip.ext.injector: Automatically uses the Pill (Insanity from %s) and the Immunosuppressant (cyberpsychosis from %s), one injection at a time with a cooldown. Uses items from your inventory. Toggle on the wheel.
sandevistan.battery.empty: The battery ran out! Implants that use energy stopped working.
sandevistan.bench.locked: Recipe locked: complete the Tier %s License quest with the Ripperdoc.
sandevistan.quest.title: Ripperdoc Licenses
sandevistan.quest.all: All licenses unlocked. You can craft everything.
sandevistan.quest.desc.2: The Ripperdoc only releases tier II parts to those who prove they can handle what they have. Accept, work and come back.
sandevistan.quest.desc.3: Tier III toys with systems that kill whoever misuses them. Prove you can take it.
sandevistan.quest.desc.4: Only the Jetpack, Arc Reactor and Mantis Blades reach tier IV. You have to hunt what nobody hunts.
sandevistan.quest.reward: Reward: %s emeralds, %s levels and tier %s crafts
sandevistan.quest.nodeliver: You don't have the requested parts.
sandevistan.quest.ready: Quest ready! Return to the Ripperdoc to complete it.
sandevistan.quest.unlocked: Tier %s license unlocked! Those crafts are now available at the Bench.
sandevistan.quest.rip.accept.2: Want better parts? Show me work: robots on the ground, Sandevistan time and material in my hand.
sandevistan.quest.rip.accept.3: Tier III is no toy. More robots, an Elder Guardian and high-precision parts. Don't come back empty-handed.
sandevistan.quest.rip.accept.4: Want the top? Bring me the Warden and the Wither, a mountain of scrap and nerves of steel. Not for everyone.
sandevistan.quest.rip.deliver: Hm. Good parts. Keep bringing them.
sandevistan.quest.rip.done.2: Clean work. License II is yours.
sandevistan.quest.rip.done.3: Impressive. License III released. Don't get used to it.
sandevistan.quest.rip.done.4: I never thought you'd do it. License IV. Don't make me regret it.
sandevistan.quest.rip.max: You already have every license. I've got nothing left to prove to you.
